name: Erogaki ni Hamaru Kanojo
original_name: エロガキに嵌まる彼女
source:
My childhood friend was stolen away from me by a perverted bastard...
But that was only the beginning of her fall. By the time I realized, it was all too late...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE198609.html] DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的青梅竹马被一个变态混蛋夺走了……

可那只是她堕落的开始。等我意识到时，一切都已经太迟……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE198609.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
